sequenced-collection-first-last.title: SequencedCollection first and last operations
sequenced-collection-first-last.summary: SequencedCollection adds a common API for accessing and modifying the first and last elements of encounter-ordered collections.
sequenced-collection-first-last.why: Java 21 gives lists and other sequenced collections a shared vocabulary for operations at both ends.
sequenced-collection-first-last.tips: Use reversed() when you need a reverse-ordered view rather than copying and reversing the collection.

virtual-thread-blocking-model.title: Virtual threads and blocking tasks
virtual-thread-blocking-model.short: Use lightweight threads for high-concurrency blocking work
virtual-thread-blocking-model.summary: Virtual threads let thread-per-task code scale to many concurrent tasks that spend much of their time blocked.
virtual-thread-blocking-model.why: They reduce the resource cost of waiting threads without changing ordinary blocking APIs into callback-based code.
virtual-thread-blocking-model.tips: Do not treat virtual threads as a way to make CPU-bound work faster; concurrency limits for scarce external resources still matter.

hex-format-bytes.title: Format and parse hexadecimal bytes
hex-format-bytes.short: Convert byte arrays and hexadecimal text
hex-format-bytes.summary: HexFormat provides standard hexadecimal formatting and parsing without hand-written digit loops.
hex-format-bytes.why: A library API avoids subtle mistakes in case handling, delimiters, and byte conversion.
hex-format-bytes.tips: Configure delimiter, prefix, suffix, and letter case on the HexFormat instance when a protocol requires a specific representation.

random-generator-factory.title: Choose a random generator by factory
random-generator-factory.summary: RandomGeneratorFactory exposes the modern random-generator algorithms through a common API.
random-generator-factory.why: Code can choose an algorithm by capability or name while depending on the RandomGenerator interface.
random-generator-factory.tips: Do not use general-purpose RandomGenerator implementations for passwords, tokens, or other security-sensitive randomness.

file-system-loop-exception.title: FileSystemLoopException
file-system-loop-exception.short: Detect a cycle while traversing files
file-system-loop-exception.summary: FileSystemLoopException reports a filesystem cycle, commonly involving symbolic links during traversal.
file-system-loop-exception.why: Following links recursively can revisit an ancestor and would otherwise make traversal loop indefinitely.
file-system-loop-exception.tips: Choose link-following behavior deliberately and report the offending path when handling traversal failures.

completion-exception-async.title: CompletionException from asynchronous work
completion-exception-async.short: Unwrap failures reported by completion stages
completion-exception-async.summary: CompletionException wraps a failure produced while completing asynchronous computation.
completion-exception-async.why: Methods such as CompletableFuture.join need an unchecked wrapper to propagate a task's underlying failure.
completion-exception-async.tips: Inspect getCause() at a boundary where you can meaningfully classify or report the original failure.

record-extra-instance-field-error.title: Records cannot declare extra instance fields
record-extra-instance-field-error.short: Keep record instance state in components
record-extra-instance-field-error.summary: A record body cannot add non-static instance fields beyond the state declared by its record components.
record-extra-instance-field-error.why: A record's state is defined explicitly by its component list.
record-extra-instance-field-error.tips: Add a record component when the value belongs to each instance, or use a static field only for class-wide state.

pattern-switch-dominated-case-error.title: Dominated pattern in switch
pattern-switch-dominated-case-error.short: Put specific patterns before broader ones
pattern-switch-dominated-case-error.summary: A pattern switch rejects a case that can never match because an earlier case already matches every value it could accept.
pattern-switch-dominated-case-error.why: A broad type pattern before a subtype pattern makes the subtype case unreachable.
pattern-switch-dominated-case-error.tips: Order type patterns from more specific to more general and keep the default or total pattern last.

rawtypes-lint-generic-use.title: Raw type lint warning
rawtypes-lint-generic-use.summary: The rawtypes lint warning flags use of a generic type without its type arguments.
rawtypes-lint-generic-use.why: Raw types bypass part of generic type checking and can move errors to runtime.
rawtypes-lint-generic-use.tips: Use parameterized types and the diamond operator; isolate unavoidable legacy raw APIs at a narrow boundary.

mutable-hashmap-key.title: Mutating a HashMap key
mutable-hashmap-key.short: Keep hash keys stable while stored
mutable-hashmap-key.summary: Changing fields used by equals or hashCode after inserting a key can make its map entry effectively unreachable by lookup.
mutable-hashmap-key.why: HashMap chooses a bucket from the key's hash at insertion time and does not relocate the entry when the object changes.
mutable-hashmap-key.tips: Prefer immutable key objects and base equality and hashing only on fields that stay stable for the key's lifetime in the map.
